cause_quote: The new fallback `findTrailingCallPrefix(candidate, matcher, resolveProtectedRanges, leading.end)?.start` parsed the same Markdown buffer again after the sequence scan had already resolved its protected ranges.
user_saw: Replies containing call-like text could take longer to stream.
summary: The fix shares Markdown protection results across candidate scans and avoids full parses when the incoming text settles paragraph ambiguity before the first candidate.
reasoning: I checked #172440 and its parent: the leading-call branch previously used a grammar-only tail scan after the sequence scan, and #172440 routed that branch through a helper that eagerly resolved Markdown protection again. The fix's call-plus-unfinished-marker test covers that branch and reduces same-text resolver calls from three to two. The fix also improves a separate admission fallback that already existed in the original fence fast path.
